scope: Append-only extension to the existing L6K_ worn-party asset library; no original prefab, gameplay controller, or Studio instance is modified by this module.

coordinate_contract.room_origin: center of floor at finished floor elevation
coordinate_contract.floor_finish: separate 0.04-stud visual mesh above the structural collision slab
coordinate_contract.straight_join_example: With equal rotation, place the next room center 24 studs along local +Y so its JoinSouth touches this room's JoinNorth.
coordinate_contract.minimum_unobstructed_center_lane: local X -3 to +3, floor to 6 studs, across the full room depth

KitchenPrepBench.description: Four-leg battered steel preparation counter with an open basin, drain, lower rack, and short bent tap.

KitchenShelf.description: Pressed metal rack with mixed cardboard cartons, cups, and worn cookware.

KitchenHood.description: Wall-mounted sheet-metal canopy, grease grille, and square extractor duct.

KitchenFridge.description: Yellowed two-door refrigerator with blunt handles and base ventilation.

KitchenStove.description: Four-burner range with enamel top, oven window, and mechanical control knobs.

KitchenWasteBin.description: Tapered institutional refuse bin with dark opening and scuffed label.

KitchenTrayStack.description: Four bent steel catering trays, placed on the preparation surface.

StaffBreakCounter.description: Cheap laminate break counter with an old box microwave and steel coffee urn.

RoomKitchenPrep.role: kitchen and food preparation side pocket

RoomUtilityHall.role: maintenance extension with a repair bench, shelving, electrical panel, and mop cart

RoomStaffNook.role: former staff break area retaining a little of the party venue's red trim

export_contract.source_collections: New prefabs and room shells are stored under L6_RevisionSections. Existing L6K_ collections are referenced, never overwritten.
export_contract.fixture_instances: Room collections hold Blender collection-instance empties. Flatten these at export or export child props separately; direct col.all_objects alone omits instance geometry.
export_contract.collision: Tagged export_collision_only proxies are already present on each room, including transformed fixture collision boxes. Do not also duplicate child prefab collision at room placement.
export_contract.uv: The caller applies its physical material UV mapping to visual meshes after authoring. No bump displacement or tessellation is generated here.
export_contract.visual_lights: Fluorescent frame and diffuser remain separate collection instances so the established blackout/flicker controller can own lighting. This module does not add Roblox Light objects.

blender_smoke_measurement.test_scope: Fresh background Blender process with placeholder existing L6K_ collections and supplied materials; source authoring and object counts only. No game playtest or Studio validation.
